edition_notes: Original Edition; copyright Exploding Kittens 2022; 56 cards, 2-5 players

items.rule: Remove all 4 Exploding Kitten cards from the deck and set them aside.
Remove all 6 Defuse cards from the deck and deal 1 Defuse to each player.
Put the extra Defuse cards back into the deck (in a 2 or 3 player game, put back only 2 extra Defuse cards and remove the rest from the game).
Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards face down to each player, so each player has 8 cards (7 + 1 Defuse); hands are kept secret.
Insert Exploding Kittens into the deck so there is 1 fewer than the number of players (e.g. 3 kittens for 4 players, 2 for 3 players); remove extra kittens from the game.
Shuffle the deck and place it face down in the middle as the Draw Pile, leaving space for a Discard Pile.
Choose any player to go first.
On your turn, either Play cards or Pass (play no cards); play continues clockwise.
Playing a card: place it face up on the Discard Pile and follow its instructions; you may then play as many further cards as you like.
You end your turn by drawing the top card of the Draw Pile into your hand (unless a card says you end the turn without drawing).
If you draw an Exploding Kitten, you explode and are out of the game unless you play a Defuse card; you discard your whole hand including the kitten.
Defuse: play it when you draw an Exploding Kitten, placing it in the Discard Pile; then secretly reinsert the kitten into the Draw Pile anywhere you like, without reordering or viewing other cards.
A Defused kitten can be placed on top of the deck to hurt the next player; the deck may be held under the table to hide the placement.
There is no maximum or minimum hand size; if your hand is empty just keep playing and draw on your turn.
Attack: do not draw; end your turn and force the next player to take 2 turns in a row.
If the victim of an Attack plays an Attack, the new target must take any remaining turns plus 2 more (e.g. 4 turns, then 6).
Skip: immediately end your turn without drawing; against an Attack it ends only 1 of the 2 turns (two Skips end both).
Favor: force another player to give you 1 card of their choice from their hand.
Shuffle: shuffle the Draw Pile thoroughly.
See the Future: privately look at the top 3 cards of the Draw Pile and return them in the same order, without showing others.

Nope: can be played at any time before an action begins, even out of turn, to stop any action except an Exploding Kitten or Defuse; the Noped card is treated as never played and is lost in the Discard Pile.
A Nope can be Noped to negate it (a Yup), and so on; a Nope can also be played on a combo.
Cat cards have no power alone; playing 2 matching Cat cards as a Pair lets you steal a random card from any player.
Two of a kind (special combos): a pair of any cards with the same title (not just Cat cards) steals a random card from another player; ignore the cards' own instructions.
Three of a kind: playing 3 cards with the same title lets you pick a player and name a card; if they have it they must give you one, otherwise you get nothing; ignore the cards' instructions.
The game ends when only 1 player remains, as all others have exploded.
There are no points; the game is won by survival.
The last player who has not exploded wins the game.
No tie-break is needed, since exactly one player is left standing.
